study: Preserving a frozen activity decision while translating measurements between co-located PAMAP2 accelerometers
design_status: Locally fixed before evaluating restoration methods on held-out subjects

cohort.recordings: Official Protocol sessions for subjects 101 through 108; subject 109 and optional sessions are outside this cohort
cohort.window: 200 consecutive synchronized samples, disjoint within runs of one activity, no gap above 0.025 seconds, both channels finite
cohort.observed: Nominal ±6g accelerometer at each of the hand, chest and ankle
cohort.reference: Nominal ±16g accelerometer at the same body locations; a measured reference channel
cohort.features: Per axis and body site: mean, standard deviation, root mean square, maximum absolute acceleration and mean absolute adjacent increment
cohort.folds: Leave one subject out. Fit the scaler on pooled reference features from the other seven subjects. Test features, paired references and labels are inaccessible to fitting.

models.head: Multinomial logistic regression, C=1, fitted on reference features and activity labels from the training subjects
models.policy: Keep each low-range input's initial label and more than 0.0001 of every initial rival margin on the deployed straight segment or the exact original flow
models.prior: Two k-means prototypes per training activity, weighted by training cluster counts, pooled isotropic residual variance and recorded train-pair discrepancy variance
models.original_flow: Set horizon to log(1 + discrepancy variance / within-cluster variance). Predeclare dyadic fractions 1, 1/2, 1/4 and 1/8. Use the largest outward-certified fraction or zero. Apply 16 RK4 steps and verify the chord to the returned endpoint separately.
models.baselines: Observed input; training mean reference-minus-observed calibration; paired ridge residual regression alpha=1; paired ExtraTrees residual regression with 64 trees, min_samples_leaf=8 and max_features=0.75. For every predicted candidate report direct estimate, straight-line clipping and Euclidean projection into the same affine cell.
models.projection: Halfspace Dykstra candidate with binary64 outward check. Keep the original input on abstention, and report abstentions.

analysis.primary: Difference in standardized squared feature error relative to the observed input, averaged within each subject and then across subjects. Report results for all predefined methods and comparisons.
analysis.secondary: Absolute error of the high-range peak across all axes in m/s²; policy changes, reserve abstention/fallback, exact-path coverage and retained horizon
analysis.tail: Subset determined by observed peak alone at or above 0.95 × 6 × 9.80665 m/s². Report reference channel near own nominal range separately.
analysis.uncertainty: Report subject outcomes, then descriptive 2.5/97.5 percentiles of subject-block bootstrap of paired frozen predictions (10,000 draws, seed 24617). Overlap among training folds and fixed cohort limit population inference.
analysis.interpretation: Translation to a co-located reference channel. Translating a feature vector can preserve a wrong input label. Decision retention has value only where a frozen downstream policy is required. A fitted prior may be inferior to supervised calibration.
